messages.feishu.connection.auth-help: Use a custom organization app with credentials in app_id:app_secret format. To import document content, grant read access and share the document with the app. Wiki links also require wiki read access. Feed requires im access to read chats.
messages.feishu.connection.inbound: Feed reads chats; Artifacts imports documents
messages.feishu.connection.title: Feishu
messages.feishu.guide.cli-link: Install and configure the official Feishu CLI
messages.feishu.guide.cli-note: Start sign-in with the official CLI from the app and use the approved read-only permissions of the user.
messages.feishu.guide.oauth-note: The provider supports OAuth for users. Molis Work currently authorizes users through the Feishu CLI.
messages.feishu.guide.token-note: For a custom organization app, use app_id:app_secret with the tenant app identity.
